messages:
incident-bot: PAGING: latency_slo_breach detected on /v1/generate (p99 > 2.5s) — auto-incident opened. Page: @jamie_sre @marc_oncall :rotating_light:

nina_support: seeing multiple customer threads reporting "responses very slow" for streaming chat. Support ticket IDs: #4923, #4927. Root cause unknown. Escalating to oncall.

jamie_sre: on it. I see p95 jumped from ~250ms to ~1.8s around 13:12 UTC, p99 trending 3s+. Streaming stalls spikes visible in the gateway.

marc_oncall: taking lead. tagging eng-runtime and eng-platform. Are we seeing error rates up or just latency?

emily_p: error rates small, <0.1% for http 5xx, but a lot of long tail timeouts on the streaming mux. Metrics: stream_churn up, kv-cache hit rate normal.

raj: digging into control-plane logs — auth token fetch latencies spiking to 800ms from token-store. Also seeing a backlog in configfetch requests to configstore. Could be cascading.

liz_ops: we have a backlog on the control-plane queue: config-fetch workers are maxed, backlog ~1200 requests. Rate limiter on configstore shows quota hits for refreshes from many inference nodes.

jamie_sre: good catch. hypothesis: feature-flag polling + token refresh concurrently causing thundering herd to configstore/token-store under certain traffic patterns, causing inference proxy to wait during request start and stall streaming.

nina_support: customers affected mostly in EU region — any idea if route-level routing caused cross-region fallback?

marc_oncall: checking routing: most traffic pinned to eu-west as expected, but fallback to us-west occurred for ~2% of requests when some instances hit capacity. Those fallbacks had much higher latencies.

emily_p: stack traces from the streaming handler show long time waiting on auth.VerifyToken RPC and then config.fetch for feature flags before starting stream.

jamie_sre: immediate mitigation options: 1) increase token-store read throughput (scale up pods), 2) temporarily relax feature-flag poll frequency via rollout config, 3) route EU overflow to dedicated reserved pool (if capacity). Which can we do fastest?

liz_ops: I can scale token-store horizontally — will take ~3-4min to spin new pods and warm. I can also bump rate limits for internal control-plane clients to reduce throttling for short window.

raj: configstore change is riskier (rollout), but we can add a short-circuit: serve cached featureflag values for 30s to avoid synchronous fetch on request path. That can be done via a quick toggle in the control-plane proxy config.

marc_oncall: prioritize fastest low-risk changes first. Liz, can you scale token-store and bump internal RL? Jamie/Raj, can you push the short-circuit toggle? If yes, aim for 10min to measurable improvement. I'll coordinate customer comms.

liz_ops: scaling token-store now: `kubectl scale deployment/token-store --replicas=8 --namespace=controlplane` — starting. Will monitor.

deploy-bot: Deployment token-store scaled from 3 -> 8 replicas by liz_ops at 13:18:42 UTC.

jamie_sre: applying short-circuit flag to control-plane proxy (non-blocking toggle). Patch: `FEATURE_FLAG_SYNC_MODE=stale-30s` on proxy configmap, restarting 2 canaries first.

deploy-bot: control-plane-proxy configmap updated by jamie_sre. Rolling restart initiated for canaries (2/40).

emily_p: after canaries restarted latency p95 dropped ~30% for canaries, streaming start latency decreased by ~400ms.

marc_oncall: good. roll to remainder if stable. Liz keep an eye on token-store pod CPU and RPS.

liz_ops: token-store pods target CPU ~70% now, RPS doubled but no OOMs. Throttling on configstore decreased by 60%.

raj: monitoring logs — the number of Authenticate RPC timeouts reduced to near-zero for canaries. Overall streaming stall incidents falling.

nina_support: sharing interim note with affected customers: "We've implemented short-term mitigation to reduce streaming stalls and are monitoring. Will update in 30m."

jamie_sre: rolling to remainder: restarting control-plane-proxy in batches of 6. Observability: watch p99 and streaming stall count.

deploy-bot: control-plane-proxy rollout 50% complete (20/40) — initiated by jamie_sre.

emily_p: after partial rollout (50%) p99 across service decreased from ~3.2s -> ~1.4s, p95 back within SLO. Streaming stall rate down ~82% from peak.

marc_oncall: marking customer-impact -> degraded for ~13:12-13:22 UTC, affecting EU streaming sessions. Support please update tickets. We'll keep this incident open until stable for 30m.

raj: follow-up notes: cause summary: simultaneous spike in token refresh + feature-flag polling caused configstore and token-store to hit rate limits, queueing requests on control-plane path. Inference proxy waits for feature/token validation on stream init leading to increased tail latency.

jamie_sre: action items: (1) add jittered backoff on FF polling and token refresh for clients, (2) make feature-flag fetch async for stream init (serve stale then refresh), (3) add circuit-breaker to short-circuit configstore if QPS exceeds threshold, (4) run chaos test for token-store scaleability.

liz_ops: ops tasks: increase token-store HPA thresholds, implement auto-scale faster for control-plane queues, and add alert when configstore queue depth > 500.

emily_p: runtime/infra tasks: change default FEATURE_FLAG_SYNC_MODE to 'stale-30s' for streaming routes, and add per-route token cache TTL to reduce refresh pressure.

marc_oncall: escalation: not opening a Sev1 because availability remained high; customer impact measurable but limited to increased latency. We'll file post-incident and include ticket rollups.

nina_support: updated affected customer tickets and posted status page note: "Service degraded for streaming in EU for ~10 minutes; mitigations applied. Investigating root cause."

jamie_sre: monitoring window. will close thread when stable 30m. Leaving logs and grep snippets for post-mortem:
```
# Samples showing backlog and token latency
controlplane-proxy[13:15:11] WARN waiting on auth.VerifyToken id=0x8a3c delay=820ms
configstore[13:15:12] ERROR rate_limited fetchKey=user_ff 429
token-store[13:15:12] INFO refresh_ms=842
```

raj: adding links to dashboards: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/streams/streaming-latency?from=now-2h&to=now and token-store heatmap.

marc_oncall: thanks team. keeping incident open until 13:52 (30m stable). If anything regresses, re-page.

liz_ops: token-store autoscaler logs show scale events recovered within 4min; noting ops runbook gaps for faster recovery.

emily_p: scheduling a post-incident sync tomorrow 10:00 to review fixes and timeline. I'll own the postmortem draft.

nina_support: closing customer comms loop after postmortem.

incident-bot: Incident note appended to ticket INC-2026 by marc_oncall: "latency spiral due to control-plane queueing during token/flag refresh spike; mitigated via short-circuit and token-store scaling."

marc_oncall: closing thread for now, will reopen if metrics slip. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
